description:
[Results] List the merchant's interview results. Rows carry the candidate's scores and recruiter risk flags, so this returns 20 by default; `offset` pages while `pagination.has_more` is true, and `tab`/`interview_id`/`filter_text`/`owner`/`position_def_step_id` narrow it. extended=true adds the owner, time on the step, outcome and decision reason. tab=shortlist is the shortlisted state of an application, not a candidate tag named Shortlist (list_candidates rules find tagged candidates).

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

extended.description: When true, each row also carries its owner (assigned_profile_id, owner_profile_id, owner_name), step_since, the questionnaire score and the decision (outcome, outcome_at, hire_start_date, decision_reason_id, decision_reason_label, decision_reason_note, withdrawn_at).

filter_emoji.description: Filter by the candidate emoji marker.

filter_text.description: Case-insensitive search on candidate name or email, or the interview / position name.

has_introduction_video.description: true: only results with a candidate video introduction; false: only results without one. Omit for all.

interview_id.description: Filter to one interview (an interview `id` from list_interviews) or position (a position `id` from list_interviews).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

order_by.description: Sort order of the result set.

owner.description: Filter by the candidate owner: staff profile ids (`profile_id` (list_users)) and/or the word unassigned, comma-separated (a row matches any of them). Needs the candidate_assignment switch (else 403).

position_def_step_id.description: Filter to the applications whose current step is this step of a position (a step `id` from get_interview_definition include=process). Matches multi-stage applications only.

profile_interview_id.description: Filter to a single candidate (the `id` of a list_candidates row).

risks.description: Comma-separated list of recruiter-risk keys to filter by (matches any).

step.description: Filter by the type of the current pipeline step. Omit for all.

tab.description: Filter by decision/completion state, as the admin results tabs do. Omit (or empty) to include all. undecided: completed and waiting for a recruiter decision, not shortlisted (undecided-interview, undecided-pre-screening and undecided-meeting narrow it to the current step type; undecided-pre-screening and undecided-meeting match multi-stage applications only); shortlist: waiting for a decision and shortlisted; decided: decided either way; decided-selected / decided-rejected: accepted / rejected (by a recruiter or the AI); submitted: the interview was submitted; completed: the candidate is done; incomplete: the candidate still has something to do; failed: the interview or its processing failed; abandoned: abandoned or stopped without speech; archived-interview: archived results; public_avatar / archived-public_avatar: public avatar sessions (single-stage only).

type.description: Product type of results to list.

name: list_interview_results
title: List interview results
